name: death-left
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT LEFT PROFILE facing screen-LEFT, exactly FOUR COMPLETE death/corpse poses in a 2x2 SQUARE grid, preferably 1536x1536. Reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Frame 1 upright human profile faces LEFT and reels, knees buckle, standing head-to-sole height about 440px. Frame 2 low crouching/kneeling collapse facing LEFT with head down. Frame 3 tips forward toward LEFT onto side, hands toward LEFT and legs trail RIGHT. Frame 4 motionless flat corpse head at LEFT and shoes at RIGHT, face/chest/near side visible, hands limp near head. Keep SAME anatomy scale across all four: crouched/corpse poses are LOWER/WIDER, never enlarged to fill standing height. Corpse complete length at most560px with generous transparent margins around hands/shoes and between all cells. Upper figures entirely above sheet horizontal midpoint; lower figures below midpoint. No floor, blood pool or effect. Only four separate figures, no clipping/touching.
